words.enDefinition: equity shares with a residual claim after higher-ranking interests

examples.en: The sample company's common stock carried voting rights and ranked below its preferred shares for distributions.
examples.zh: 样本公司的「普通股」附带表决权，在分配顺序上排在优先股之后。

examples.en: Our worksheet listed common stock and preferred stock in separate rows on the ownership table.
examples.zh: 我们的练习表在股权表中用不同行列出了「普通股」和优先股。

words.enDefinition: shares with specified priority over common stock for certain distributions

examples.en: The mock offering described preferred stock that ranked ahead of common shares for dividend payments.
examples.zh: 模拟发行文件介绍了在股息支付顺序上优先于普通股的「优先股」。

examples.en: In the case, the terms of the preferred stock specified when holders could vote.
examples.zh: 案例中，「优先股」的条款说明了持有人在何时可以表决。

words.enDefinition: preferred shares whose undeclared dividends do not carry forward

examples.en: The fictional company's noncumulative preferred stock did not carry forward dividends the board had skipped.
examples.zh: 虚构公司的「非累积优先股」不会累计董事会决定不宣派的股息。

examples.en: The tutor asked which dividend rule identified the issue as noncumulative preferred stock in the example.
examples.zh: 导师问，示例中哪一项股息条款表明这次发行的是「非累积优先股」。

words.enDefinition: preferred shares entitled to participate in additional distributions under specified terms

examples.en: The case gave holders of participating preferred stock a share of proceeds remaining after the preference payment.
examples.zh: 案例中的「参与分配优先股」持有人可以分享支付优先分配额后剩余的款项。

examples.en: Our tutor asked where the extra distribution rights for participating preferred stock appeared in the sample terms.
examples.zh: 导师问，在样本条款的哪里能看到「参与分配优先股」的额外分配权。

words.enDefinition: preferred shares that can convert into another share class on specified terms

examples.en: The sample's convertible preferred stock could become common shares at the ratio stated in the terms.
examples.zh: 样本中的「可转换优先股」可以按条款所列比例转为普通股。

examples.en: We compared the dividend terms of convertible preferred stock with those of the sample's common shares.
examples.zh: 我们把「可转换优先股」的股息条款与样本普通股的条款作了比较。

collocations: convert convertible preferred stock into common shares

words.enDefinition: preferred shares that may be redeemed under stated conditions

examples.en: The prospectus described redeemable preferred stock with a redemption price stated in the terms.
examples.zh: 招募说明书介绍了条款中列明赎回价格的「可赎回优先股」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which event could trigger redemption of the redeemable preferred stock in the case.
examples.zh: 导师问，案例中哪个事件可能触发「可赎回优先股」的赎回。

words.enDefinition: shares that generally carry no vote on ordinary shareholder matters

examples.en: The fictional company issued non-voting shares with the same dividend rights as its other common shares.
examples.zh: 虚构公司发行的「无表决权股份」与其其他普通股享有相同的股息权。

examples.en: Students noted that non-voting shares had no votes in the sample's routine election of directors.
examples.zh: 学生注意到，此样本中的「无表决权股份」在常规董事选举中没有选票。

words.enDefinition: shares carrying votes on specified matters before shareholders

examples.en: The example listed voting shares separately when calculating support for the proposed board change.
examples.zh: 示例计算拟议董事会变动的支持度时，单独列出了「有表决权股份」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how many voting shares supported the change under the case's rules.
examples.zh: 导师问，根据案例中的规则，有多少「有表决权股份」支持这项变更。

collocations: a majority of the voting shares

words.enDefinition: shares carrying more votes per share than another class

examples.en: The founder's super-voting shares carried ten votes per share in our fictional company case.
examples.zh: 在我们的虚构公司案例中，创始人的「超级表决权股份」每股有十票。

examples.en: We identified the super-voting shares before comparing the ownership percentages and votes of both classes.
examples.zh: 我们先识别了「超级表决权股份」，再比较两类股份的持股比例和票数。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement with two share classes carrying different voting rights

examples.en: The sample company used a dual-class share structure that gave founders more votes per share.
examples.zh: 样本公司采用「双重股权结构」，让创始人持有的股份享有更高的每股票数。

examples.en: Our case report explored how the dual-class share structure affected voting after the public offering.
examples.zh: 案例报告分析了「双重股权结构」在公开发行后如何影响表决。

words.enDefinition: a class of common shares labelled A by the issuer

examples.en: The fictional company's Class A common stock carried one vote per share under its stated terms.
examples.zh: 根据所列条款，这家虚构公司的「A 类普通股」每股享有一票表决权。

examples.en: The instructor asked why Class A common stock could have different rights at another company.
examples.zh: 老师问，为什么另一家公司的「A 类普通股」可能有不同的权利。

collocations: holders of Class A common stock
votes attached to Class A common stock

words.enDefinition: the right of a share class to vote separately on specified matters

examples.en: The case gave preferred holders class voting rights on changes to their dividend priority.
examples.zh: 案例给予优先股持有人「类别表决权」，可就改变其股息优先顺序的事项单独表决。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the sample amendment would trigger class voting rights for only one group.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么样本修正案只触发其中一组股东的「类别表决权」。

words.enDefinition: accumulated unpaid dividends on shares with cumulative dividend rights

examples.en: The notes showed dividends in arrears on the fictional company's cumulative preferred stock for two years.
examples.zh: 附注列出了虚构公司累积优先股两年的「拖欠股息」。

examples.en: We located dividends in arrears in the equity note before checking the reported amounts.
examples.zh: 我们在股权附注中找到了「拖欠股息」，再核对报告中的金额。

words.enDefinition: a right to payment ahead of specified equity holders in liquidation

examples.en: The sample term sheet gave preferred holders a liquidation preference over the common shareholders.
examples.zh: 样本条款清单赋予优先股持有人相对于普通股股东的「清算优先权」。

examples.en: We used the liquidation preference to read the order of payments in the fictional winding-up example.
examples.zh: 我们借助「清算优先权」理解虚构清算示例中的付款顺序。

collocations: a liquidation preference over common shares

words.enDefinition: the influence an owner has through the votes attached to holdings

examples.en: Our table used voting power to compare two shareholders with similar numbers of shares.
examples.zh: 我们通过表格中的「表决权份额」比较持股数量相近的两个股东。

examples.en: The founders retained most voting power after the sale of shares with fewer votes per share.
examples.zh: 出售每股票数较少的股份后，创始人仍保有大部分「表决权份额」。

collocations: a majority of the voting power

words.enDefinition: an ownership interest in financial benefits such as distributions

examples.en: The case compared each founder's economic interest with the votes attached to that person's shares.
examples.zh: 案例比较了各创始人的「经济权益」及其持股附带的表决票数。

examples.en: Students calculated the economic interest represented by each class using the sample distribution terms.
examples.zh: 学生根据样本分配条款计算各类股份所代表的「经济权益」。

collocations: an economic interest in the company

words.enDefinition: a holding representing less than one whole share

examples.en: The sample brokerage statement showed a fractional share beside the customer's whole-share holding.
examples.zh: 样本券商对账单在客户的整数股持仓旁列出了「不足一股的股份」。

examples.en: Our worksheet showed how a distribution could leave an investor with a fractional share.
examples.zh: 我们的练习表说明，一次分配可能让投资者得到「不足一股的股份」。

collocations: pay cash for a fractional share

words.enDefinition: the maximum number of shares a company is permitted to issue

examples.en: The case showed authorized shares in a separate column from shares already issued.
examples.zh: 案例将「授权发行股份」和已经发行的股份分栏列示。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the authorized shares figure exceeded the issued amount on the company's table.
examples.zh: 导师问，公司表中的「授权发行股份」数量为什么超过已发行数量。

words.enDefinition: shares that a company has issued to holders

examples.en: The worksheet listed issued shares before subtracting those bought back and held by the company.
examples.zh: 练习表先列出「已发行股份」，再减去公司回购并持有的股份。

examples.en: We checked the number of issued shares before reading the sample company's ownership disclosures.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「已发行股份」的数量，再阅读样本公司的股权披露。

collocations: issued shares held by the company

words.enDefinition: authorised shares that have not yet been issued

examples.en: The sample company reserved some unissued shares for use in an approved employee plan.
examples.zh: 样本公司预留了一些「未发行股份」，供已获批准的员工计划使用。

examples.en: The case asked whether enough unissued shares remained for the proposed offering of common stock.
examples.zh: 案例问，剩余的「未发行股份」够不够用于拟议的普通股发行。

words.enDefinition: issued shares currently held by parties other than the issuing company

examples.en: The case excluded shares held in treasury when it calculated the company's outstanding shares.
examples.zh: 案例计算公司的「发行在外股份」时排除了库存股。

examples.en: The ownership table showed how a new issue increased outstanding shares in the fictional company.
examples.zh: 股权表显示新发行如何增加虚构公司的「发行在外股份」。

words.enDefinition: shares a company has reacquired and continues to hold

examples.en: The sample company reported treasury shares separately from outstanding shares in its equity table.
examples.zh: 样本公司在股权表中把「库存股」和发行在外股份分开报告。

examples.en: We checked whether repurchased shares were retired or held as treasury shares in the case.
examples.zh: 我们核对了案例中回购的股份是注销还是作为「库存股」持有。

words.enDefinition: the potential share count if specified convertible or exercisable rights become shares

examples.en: Our fully diluted share count included the shares that would result from exercising all sample options.
examples.zh: 我们的「完全摊薄股数」计入了假设行使样本中所有期权后产生的股份。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to state which instruments were included in the fully diluted share count.
examples.zh: 导师让我们说明哪些工具纳入了「完全摊薄股数」。

collocations: calculate the fully diluted share count
disclose a fully diluted share count
assumptions for a fully diluted share count

words.zhGloss: 加权平均发行在外股数
words.enDefinition: outstanding shares averaged by the time they were outstanding during a period
acceptedZhAnswers: 加权平均发行在外股数

examples.en: The worksheet used weighted average shares outstanding because the company issued more shares halfway through the year.
examples.zh: 因为公司年中增发了股份，练习表采用「加权平均发行在外股数」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why weighted average shares outstanding differed from the count at year end.
examples.zh: 导师问，「加权平均发行在外股数」为什么与年末股数不同。

words.enDefinition: a stated nominal amount assigned to a share

examples.en: The sample charter gave each share a par value smaller than the public offering price.
examples.zh: 样本章程给每股定的「股份面值」低于公开发行价。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to separate par value from the quoted price on the exchange.
examples.zh: 导师让我们区分「股份面值」与交易所报价。

words.enDefinition: shares issued without a stated nominal value per share

examples.en: The fictional company's charter described its common shares as no-par value stock throughout the example.
examples.zh: 整份示例中，虚构公司的章程都把其普通股描述为「无面值股票」。

examples.en: Students checked the sample charter to see whether the company could issue no-par value stock.
examples.zh: 学生查阅样本章程，确认公司能否发行「无面值股票」。

collocations: a class of no-par value stock

words.enDefinition: an award delivering shares or equivalent value when conditions are met

examples.en: The sample plan described a restricted stock unit payable in shares after a stated service period.
examples.zh: 样本计划介绍了一种在规定任职期满后以股份支付的「限制性股票单位」。

examples.en: Our class compared a restricted stock unit with an already issued share in the ownership exercise.
examples.zh: 在股权练习中，我们班将「限制性股票单位」和已发行股份作了比较。

collocations: vesting of a restricted stock unit
settle a restricted stock unit in shares

words.enDefinition: a shareholder who holds a non-controlling ownership interest

examples.en: In the case, a minority shareholder questioned why the lower-vote shares received the same dividend.
examples.zh: 案例中，一名「少数股东」质疑为什么表决票数较少的股份获得同样的股息。

examples.en: The class reviewed what information a minority shareholder received before the sample company's meeting.
examples.zh: 班上查看了「少数股东」在样本公司的会议前会收到哪些信息。

collocations: a minority shareholder in the company

words.enDefinition: a shareholder able to direct key company decisions through voting power or other rights

examples.en: The fictional company's controlling shareholder had enough votes to determine who joined the board.
examples.zh: 虚构公司的「控股股东」拥有足够票数来决定谁进入董事会。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how a controlling shareholder could hold fewer shares than all other owners combined.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「控股股东」的持股数量可能少于其他所有股东的持股总和。

words.enDefinition: shares available for public trading, excluding closely held or restricted shares

examples.en: The classroom factsheet showed the company's free float alongside its total outstanding share count.
examples.zh: 课堂概况表把公司的「自由流通股数」列在发行在外股份总数旁边。

examples.en: We discussed why the sample company's free float could be much smaller than its outstanding shares.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么样本公司的「自由流通股数」可能远少于发行在外的股份。

collocations: shares included in the free float

words.enDefinition: a company's first public offer of its shares

examples.en: The class reviewed a fictional initial public offering to identify which shares the company planned to sell.
examples.zh: 同学们查阅了一次虚构的「首次公开发行」的材料，找出公司计划出售哪些股份。

examples.en: The sample initial public offering included new shares and shares sold by existing owners.
examples.zh: 样本「首次公开发行」既包含新股，也包含现有股东出售的股份。

collocations: documents for an initial public offering

words.enDefinition: listing shares for trading outside a traditional underwritten IPO

examples.en: Our tutor compared a direct listing with a traditional underwritten offering in the exchange exercise.
examples.zh: 导师在交易所相关练习中比较了「直接上市」和传统承销发行。

examples.en: The case described a direct listing in which existing shareholders were the only sellers.
examples.zh: 案例介绍了一次只有现有股东出售股份的「直接上市」。

collocations: a direct listing on an exchange

words.enDefinition: a public share offering after a company's first public offering

examples.en: The fictional listed company announced a follow-on offering two years after its initial public offering.
examples.zh: 虚构的上市公司在首次公开发行两年后宣布「上市后再发行」。

examples.en: We checked whether the follow-on offering consisted only of shares newly issued by the company.
examples.zh: 我们核对了这次「上市后再发行」是否只包含公司新发行的股份。

collocations: shares sold in a follow-on offering

words.enDefinition: an offering in which an issuer sells newly issued shares

examples.en: The case's primary offering raised money for the company because it sold newly issued shares.
examples.zh: 案例中的「发行人发售新股」为公司筹集了资金，因为出售的是新发行的股份。

examples.en: The tutor contrasted a primary offering with a sale of shares held by existing owners.
examples.zh: 导师把「发行人发售新股」与现有股东出售持股作了比较。

collocations: shares issued in a primary offering

words.enDefinition: an existing owner selling shares in an offering

examples.en: The prospectus named one selling shareholder and separately listed the shares offered by the company.
examples.zh: 招募说明书列出了一名「出售股份的股东」，并另列公司发售的股份。

examples.en: Our exercise followed which part of the offering proceeds went to the selling shareholder.
examples.zh: 练习让我们追踪本次发行所得的哪一部分归「出售股份的股东」。

collocations: proceeds received by a selling shareholder
shares offered by a selling shareholder

words.enDefinition: registration covering a potential public resale of securities already held

examples.en: The sample filing covered resale registration for shares that had been sold in an earlier transaction.
examples.zh: 样本申报文件涉及先前交易中所售股份的「转售登记」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why resale registration did not itself mean the shares had been sold.
examples.zh: 导师解释，为什么「转售登记」本身并不意味着股份已售出。

words.enDefinition: an offer giving eligible existing shareholders rights to buy additional shares

examples.en: The sample company's rights offering gave eligible existing shareholders an opportunity to buy new shares.
examples.zh: 样本公司通过「向现有股东配股」让符合条件的现有股东有机会购买新股。

examples.en: We read the timetable for the rights offering before interpreting the sample shareholder notice.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读「向现有股东配股」的时间表，再解读样本股东通知。

words.enDefinition: a right to purchase offered shares on specified terms

examples.en: In the case, each subscription right could be used to buy a stated number of shares.
examples.zh: 案例中的每项「股份认购权」可用于购买规定数量的股份。

examples.en: Our worksheet asked when a subscription right would expire under the sample offering terms.
examples.zh: 练习表问，按照样本发行条款，「股份认购权」何时到期。

collocations: the expiration of a subscription right

words.enDefinition: a right to request unsubscribed shares beyond a holder's basic allocation

examples.en: The sample rights offering included an oversubscription privilege if shares remained after basic subscriptions closed.
examples.zh: 样本配股设有「超额认购权」，适用于基本认购结束后仍有剩余股份的情形。

examples.en: We checked whether the oversubscription privilege guaranteed any additional shares in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 我们核对了虚构示例中的「超额认购权」是否保证能获得额外股份。

words.enDefinition: collecting indications of demand to help price and allocate an issue

examples.en: The class reviewed bookbuilding through a case about how an indicative price range changed.
examples.zh: 同学们通过一个初步价格区间变化的案例学习了「簿记建档」。

examples.en: The tutor described bookbuilding before asking why the final offering price differed from the estimates.
examples.zh: 导师介绍了「簿记建档」，随后问最终发行价为什么和估计值不同。

words.enDefinition: the number or total value of securities offered

examples.en: The sample prospectus expressed offering size both in shares and in estimated monetary terms.
examples.zh: 样本招募说明书用股份数量和估计金额两种方式表示「发行规模」。

examples.en: The class noted how the offering size changed between the preliminary and final documents.
examples.zh: 同学们注意到初步文件与最终文件之间的「发行规模」有何变化。

words.enDefinition: an option allowing underwriters to purchase extra shares under agreed terms

examples.en: The sample prospectus listed an over-allotment option separately from the initial number of offered shares.
examples.zh: 样本招募说明书把「超额配售选择权」和最初发售的股份数量分开列出。

examples.en: We checked whether the underwriters had exercised the over-allotment option in the fictional closing announcement.
examples.zh: 我们核对虚构的交割公告，确认承销商是否行使了「超额配售选择权」。

collocations: shares covered by an over-allotment option

words.enDefinition: a contract setting out the arrangement between an issuer and its underwriters

examples.en: The sample underwriting agreement described how many shares each participating firm agreed to purchase.
examples.zh: 样本「承销协议」说明了各参与机构同意购买的股份数量。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the underwriting agreement had a different date from the preliminary prospectus.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「承销协议」的日期与初步招募说明书不同。

words.enDefinition: underwriting in which the underwriter commits to buy the offered securities

examples.en: Firm commitment underwriting meant the underwriter agreed to buy the shares covered by the sample agreement.
examples.zh: 「全额包销」在示例中意味着承销商同意购买该协议涵盖的股份。

examples.en: Our class compared firm commitment underwriting with an arrangement that did not guarantee a purchase.
examples.zh: 同学们将「全额包销」与不保证购买的安排作了比较。

collocations: an offering with firm commitment underwriting

words.enDefinition: an offering where an intermediary seeks buyers without committing to buy unsold shares

examples.en: The fictional best-efforts offering did not require the participating broker to purchase shares left unsold.
examples.zh: 该虚构的「尽力代销发行」不要求参与券商购买未售出的股份。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what the sample's best-efforts offering agreement said about unsold shares.
examples.zh: 导师问，样本的「尽力代销发行」协议如何规定未售出的股份。

words.enDefinition: the firm coordinating the underwriting group for an offering

examples.en: The sample document named a lead underwriter and two smaller firms working on the offering.
examples.zh: 样本文件列出了一家「主承销商」及两家参与发行的较小机构。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which tasks belonged to the lead underwriter in the mock offering timetable.
examples.zh: 导师问，在模拟发行时间表中哪些任务属于「主承销商」。

collocations: the lead underwriter on an offering

words.enDefinition: the firm managing the record of orders or interest in an offering

examples.en: The sample bookrunner coordinated the collection of orders for the fictional company's share offer.
examples.zh: 样本中的「簿记管理人」协调收集虚构公司股票发售的订单。

examples.en: We found the bookrunner named beside the offering details in the mock prospectus.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟招募说明书的发行细节旁找到了「簿记管理人」的名称。

words.enDefinition: a group of firms sharing responsibility for underwriting an offering

examples.en: The underwriting syndicate in our case contained three firms with different commitments to buy shares.
examples.zh: 案例中的「承销团」由三家认购承诺不同的机构组成。

examples.en: We drew a diagram showing how the underwriting syndicate divided work for the mock offering.
examples.zh: 我们画图展示了「承销团」如何分担模拟发行的工作。

words.enDefinition: a preliminary range of possible prices for the offer

examples.en: The preliminary prospectus gave an indicative price range for each share in the fictional offering.
examples.zh: 初步招募说明书给出了虚构发行的每股「初步价格区间」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the final price could differ from the sample's indicative price range.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么最终价格可能与样本的「初步价格区间」不同。

words.enDefinition: the price at which securities are initially offered to buyers

examples.en: We found the final offering price on the cover of the sample share prospectus.
examples.zh: 我们在样本股票招募说明书封面找到了最终「发行价格」。

examples.en: The worksheet separated the offering price from the stock's first traded price on the exchange.
examples.zh: 练习表将「发行价格」与该股票在交易所的首笔成交价分开。

words.enDefinition: the date on which the final terms include an agreed price

examples.en: The fictional company's pricing date came before the first day of trading in our timetable.
examples.zh: 按我们的时间表，虚构公司的「发行定价日」早于首个交易日。

examples.en: We checked the pricing date before comparing two documents with different offering prices.
examples.zh: 我们先核对了「发行定价日」，再比较两份列出不同发行价格的文件。

collocations: terms fixed on the pricing date

words.enDefinition: compensation measured by the gap between the offering price and the underwriters' purchase price

examples.en: The sample showed the underwriting discount beside the offering price and the amount paid to the company.
examples.zh: 样本在发行价和付给公司的金额旁列出了「承销折让」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how the underwriting discount affected proceeds in the mock offering calculation.
examples.zh: 导师问，模拟发行计算中「承销折让」如何影响募集所得。

words.enDefinition: money actually raised after stated offering fees and expenses

examples.en: The company in the case stated net proceeds after deducting the underwriting charge and other expenses.
examples.zh: 案例中的公司列出了扣除承销费用和其他开支之后的「发行募集净额」。

examples.en: We compared net proceeds with the larger amount paid for all the offered shares.
examples.zh: 我们将「发行募集净额」与买入全部发售股份所支付的更高金额作了比较。

collocations: estimated net proceeds from an offering

words.enDefinition: the stated purposes for which raised funds will be used

examples.en: The use of proceeds section listed new equipment and the cost of opening a second facility.
examples.zh: 「募集资金用途」一节列出了新设备和开设第二处设施的费用。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the sample issuer changed its use of proceeds after amending the filing.
examples.zh: 导师问，样本发行人在修改申报文件后是否改变了「募集资金用途」。

collocations: describe the planned use of proceeds

words.enDefinition: a reduction in an existing holder's ownership percentage

examples.en: The worksheet illustrated ownership dilution when the fictional company issued additional shares to new investors.
examples.zh: 练习表说明，虚构公司向新投资者增发股份时如何造成「持股比例稀释」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which assumptions mattered when calculating ownership dilution under the two proposed share issues.
examples.zh: 导师问，计算两项拟议发行下的「持股比例稀释」时，哪些假设重要。

words.enDefinition: presentations to prospective investors before an initial public offering

examples.en: Our case described an IPO roadshow at which the company presented its business plans to investors.
examples.zh: 案例介绍了一场「首次公开发行路演」，会上公司向投资者介绍了经营计划。

examples.en: The class identified which estimates appeared during the IPO roadshow but not in the final prospectus.
examples.zh: 同学们找出哪些估计值出现在「首次公开发行路演」中，却未出现在最终招募说明书里。

words.enDefinition: the date on which shares are listed on an exchange

examples.en: The sample exchange notice showed the listing date beside the company's new trading symbol.
examples.zh: 样本交易所公告在公司的新交易代码旁列出了「上市日期」。

examples.en: We compared the listing date with the earlier date on which the offer price was set.
examples.zh: 我们将「上市日期」和更早确定发行价的日期作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a US filing providing disclosures to register a securities offering

examples.en: The fictional issuer's registration statement included the prospectus and other required disclosures for the offering.
examples.zh: 虚构发行人的「证券发行登记文件」包含招募说明书及该发行要求的其他披露信息。

examples.en: Our tutor traced a pricing change through several amendments to the sample registration statement.
examples.zh: 导师通过样本「证券发行登记文件」的几次修订追踪发行价格的变化。

words.enDefinition: a SEC registration form commonly used for US public equity offerings

examples.en: Our class identified the prospectus section in a fictional Form S-1 prepared for a public offering.
examples.zh: 我们在一份为公开发行编制的虚构「美国S-1发行登记表」中找到了招募说明书部分。

examples.en: The sample Form S-1 described the company's share classes and its proposed use of proceeds.
examples.zh: 样本「美国S-1发行登记表」介绍了公司的股份类别和计划中的募集资金用途。

words.enDefinition: the date on which a securities registration statement becomes legally effective

examples.en: The sample timeline marked the registration effective date before the final pricing documents appeared.
examples.zh: 样本时间线在最终定价文件发布前标出了「证券注册生效日」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the registration effective date did not establish the company's investment merits.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「证券注册生效日」并不说明这家公司的投资价值。

collocations: events after the registration effective date

words.enDefinition: an early offering prospectus that may omit final terms

examples.en: The preliminary prospectus did not yet give the final issue price in our classroom case.
examples.zh: 在课堂案例中，「初步招募说明书」尚未给出最终发行价。

examples.en: We compared the risk disclosures in the preliminary prospectus with the later version of the document.
examples.zh: 我们把「初步招募说明书」中的风险披露与文件的后续版本作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the offering prospectus containing final terms and related disclosures

examples.en: The sample final prospectus included the agreed offering price and the final number of shares.
examples.zh: 样本「最终招募说明书」包含商定的发行价和最终发售股数。

examples.en: The class reviewed the final prospectus before completing the mock ownership table for the issuer.
examples.zh: 同学们先阅读「最终招募说明书」，再填写发行人的模拟股权表。

collocations: the terms in the final prospectus

words.enDefinition: a table showing who owns company shares and on what basis

examples.en: The capitalization table showed how ownership changed after the fictional company issued another class of shares.
examples.zh: 「股权结构表」说明虚构公司发行另一类股份后股权如何变化。

examples.en: Our class used the capitalization table to distinguish outstanding shares from potential shares under options.
examples.zh: 我们用「股权结构表」区分了发行在外股份与期权可能形成的股份。

words.enDefinition: an agreement restricting sales of specified shares for a period

examples.en: The sample prospectus described a lock-up agreement covering shares held by two of the founders.
examples.zh: 样本招募说明书介绍了一份涵盖两名创始人持股的「股份锁定协议」。

examples.en: We read the lock-up agreement to see which holdings the fictional parties had agreed to restrict.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「股份锁定协议」，确认虚构当事人同意对哪些持股加以限制。

words.enDefinition: the period during which specified shares are subject to sale restrictions

examples.en: The fictional issuer's lock-up period ended on the date stated in the schedule.
examples.zh: 虚构发行人的「股份锁定期」于时间表所列日期结束。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which holdings were still subject to the lock-up period in the later filing.
examples.zh: 导师问，后续申报文件中哪些持股仍受「股份锁定期」限制。

collocations: the end of a lock-up period
shares covered during the lock-up period

words.enDefinition: a US registration allowing eligible securities to be offered later under applicable conditions

examples.en: The sample company's shelf registration covered securities that it might offer at a later date.
examples.zh: 样本公司的「储架发行登记」涵盖将来可能发售的证券。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the shelf registration alone showed that any shares had already been sold.
examples.zh: 导师问，仅凭「储架发行登记」能否看出已经出售了股份。

collocations: securities covered by a shelf registration

words.enDefinition: documents giving shareholders information and options for an upcoming vote

examples.en: The sample proxy materials included a description of the proposals and a form for voting.
examples.zh: 样本「股东委托投票材料」包括提案说明和一份投票表格。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which parts of the proxy materials explained how each proposal would be counted.
examples.zh: 导师问，「股东委托投票材料」的哪些部分解释了每个提案如何计票。

collocations: proxy materials for a shareholder meeting

words.enDefinition: a document explaining matters on which shareholders are asked to vote

examples.en: The proxy statement described the nominees and explained the sample company's voting standards.
examples.zh: 「股东委托投票说明书」介绍了候选人，并解释了样本公司的表决规则。

examples.en: We compared the proxy statement with the shorter notice announcing the company's annual meeting.
examples.zh: 我们把「股东委托投票说明书」和较短的公司年度会议通知作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a form by which a registered holder appoints a proxy

examples.en: The registered shareholder used the sample proxy card to appoint someone to act at the meeting.
examples.zh: 登记股东用样本「股东投票委托卡」指定某人在会议上代为表决。

examples.en: The proxy card in the exercise listed separate choices for every director nominee.
examples.zh: 练习中的「股东投票委托卡」为每名董事候选人分别列出选项。

words.enDefinition: a form for a beneficial owner to direct an intermediary's vote

examples.en: The sample broker sent a voting instruction form to customers whose shares it held.
examples.zh: 样本券商向由其代持股份的客户发送了「表决指示表」。

examples.en: We compared the voting instruction form with the proxy card sent to a registered shareholder.
examples.zh: 我们把「表决指示表」与发给登记股东的投票委托卡作了比较。

words.enDefinition: to have a representative cast a shareholder's vote

examples.en: The exercise showed how a shareholder could vote by proxy while travelling outside the country.
examples.zh: 练习展示了股东出国旅行期间怎样「委托他人表决」。

examples.en: Our tutor compared shareholders who planned to vote by proxy with those attending in person.
examples.zh: 导师比较了计划「委托他人表决」的股东和亲自到场的股东。

collocations: vote by proxy at a meeting
be entitled to vote by proxy

words.enDefinition: a document from a nominee authorising the beneficial owner to vote directly

examples.en: The sample meeting materials explained why a beneficial owner might need a legal proxy to vote directly.
examples.zh: 样本会议材料解释了受益所有人直接投票时为什么可能需要「正式表决授权文件」。

examples.en: Our exercise identified the legal proxy as the document conferring voting authority in the case.
examples.zh: 练习确认，「正式表决授权文件」是案例中授予表决权的文件。

words.expression: notice of internet availability of proxy materials
words.lemma: notice of internet availability of proxy materials
words.zhGloss: 委托投票材料上网通知
words.enDefinition: a US notice that voting materials are accessible online
acceptedZhAnswers: 委托投票材料上网通知
acceptedEnVariants: notice of internet availability of proxy materials

examples.en: The notice of internet availability of proxy materials gave the web address for the sample meeting documents.
examples.zh: 「委托投票材料上网通知」给出了可查看样本会议文件的网址。

examples.en: We read a notice of internet availability of proxy materials before opening the sample proxy statement.
examples.zh: 在打开样本股东委托投票说明书前，我们读了一份「委托投票材料上网通知」。

collocations: send a notice of internet availability of proxy materials
receive a notice of internet availability of proxy materials
details in the notice of internet availability of proxy materials

words.enDefinition: a document announcing an annual shareholder meeting and its details

examples.en: The notice of annual meeting gave the time and place for the fictional company's vote.
examples.zh: 「年度股东大会通知」列明了虚构公司股东表决的时间和地点。

examples.en: We checked the notice of annual meeting before reading the sample's proposed resolutions.
examples.zh: 阅读样本的拟议决议前，我们查阅了「年度股东大会通知」。

collocations: issue a notice of annual meeting
circulate the notice of annual meeting
details in a notice of annual meeting

words.enDefinition: a company meeting held once a year for shareholder business

examples.en: At the sample annual meeting of shareholders, investors voted on several directors and one proposal.
examples.zh: 在样本「年度股东大会」上，投资者就数名董事人选和一项提案投票。

examples.en: We checked which business belonged on the agenda for the annual meeting of shareholders.
examples.zh: 我们核对了哪些事项应纳入「年度股东大会」的议程。

collocations: hold an annual meeting of shareholders
attend the annual meeting of shareholders
agenda for the annual meeting of shareholders

words.enDefinition: a shareholder meeting called outside the regular annual meeting

examples.en: The fictional company called a special meeting of shareholders to discuss a proposed transaction.
examples.zh: 虚构公司召开了「临时股东大会」，讨论一项拟议交易。

examples.en: The agenda for the special meeting of shareholders listed only one matter for a vote.
examples.zh: 「临时股东大会」的议程只列出一项表决事项。

collocations: call a special meeting of shareholders
notice of a special meeting of shareholders
attend a special meeting of shareholders

words.enDefinition: a proposal submitted by a shareholder for consideration at a meeting

examples.en: The proxy documents included a shareholder proposal asking the company to publish a new report.
examples.zh: 股东委托投票文件包含一项「股东提案」，要求公司发布一份新报告。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to find the shareholder proposal that had come from outside management.
examples.zh: 导师让我们找出并非由管理层提出的那项「股东提案」。

words.enDefinition: an item proposed by company management for a shareholder vote

examples.en: The sample management proposal asked investors to approve a change to the company's share structure.
examples.zh: 样本「管理层提案」请求投资者批准变更公司的股份结构。

examples.en: Our worksheet compared a management proposal with an item put forward by a shareholder.
examples.zh: 练习表将「管理层提案」和一项由股东提出的事项作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a person put forward for election to a board

examples.en: The proxy statement gave a short biography of each director nominee in the sample election.
examples.zh: 股东委托投票说明书提供了样本选举中每位「董事候选人」的简历。

examples.en: We checked which director nominee had previously worked in the same industry as the company.
examples.zh: 我们核对了哪位「董事候选人」以前在与公司相同的行业工作。

words.enDefinition: a system allowing votes for several seats to be concentrated on one candidate

examples.en: The case used cumulative voting to let minority shareholders concentrate votes on a single nominee.
examples.zh: 案例用「累积投票制」让少数股东可以把选票集中给一名候选人。

examples.en: We distributed hypothetical votes across candidates to understand cumulative voting in the sample board election.
examples.zh: 我们把假设选票分给各候选人，以理解模拟董事选举中的「累积投票制」。

words.enDefinition: a system electing candidates with the most votes regardless of an absolute majority

examples.en: The fictional election used plurality voting and awarded seats to the candidates with the most votes.
examples.zh: 虚构选举采用「相对多数投票制」，得票最多的候选人当选。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how plurality voting would treat a candidate receiving less than half the votes.
examples.zh: 导师问，在「相对多数投票制」下，怎样处理获得不足半数选票的候选人。

words.enDefinition: a voting system requiring more than half of a specified vote total

examples.en: The example used majority voting and defined which ballots counted toward the required total.
examples.zh: 示例采用「过半数投票制」，并明确哪些选票计入所需总数。

examples.en: Our group checked how majority voting affected the outcome when several shareholders abstained.
examples.zh: 我们小组核对了数名股东弃权时，「过半数投票制」如何影响结果。

words.enDefinition: a non-vote where a broker lacks both client instructions and voting discretion

examples.en: The sample report recorded a broker non-vote on the proposal requesting a change to share rights.
examples.zh: 样本报告在请求变更股份权利的提案上记录了一项「券商未代投票」。

examples.en: Our tutor distinguished a broker non-vote from a shareholder's decision to abstain in the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师在练习中区分了「券商未代投票」和股东决定弃权。

collocations: a broker non-vote on a proposal

words.enDefinition: to choose not to cast a vote for or against

examples.en: The fictional shareholder chose to abstain from voting on a proposal involving the new director.
examples.zh: 虚构股东选择在涉及新董事的提案表决中「弃权」。

examples.en: Our class discussed what it meant to abstain from voting in the sample tally.
examples.zh: 我们班讨论了在样本票数统计中「弃权」意味着什么。

collocations: abstain from voting on a proposal

words.enDefinition: to decline to authorise a proxy to vote for a candidate

examples.en: The fictional proxy card let shareholders withhold voting authority for an individual director nominee.
examples.zh: 虚构的股东投票委托卡允许股东对单名董事候选人「不给予委托投票权」。

examples.en: We checked where holders could withhold voting authority in the sample director election materials.
examples.zh: 我们核对了在样本董事选举材料里，持有人可以在何处选择「不给予委托投票权」。

collocations: withhold voting authority for a nominee
an option to withhold voting authority

words.enDefinition: a vote intended to convey views without binding the decision maker

examples.en: The fictional company held an advisory vote to learn shareholders' views on the proposed policy.
examples.zh: 虚构公司举行「咨询性表决」，了解股东对拟议政策的意见。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the advisory vote mattered even though its result was not binding.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「咨询性表决」的结果即使没有约束力也有意义。

words.enDefinition: a shareholder vote expressing a view on executive compensation

examples.en: The sample US proxy statement listed a say-on-pay vote about the company's executive compensation.
examples.zh: 美国样本股东委托投票说明书列出了一项关于该公司高管报酬的「高管薪酬表决」。

examples.en: We looked for the compensation discussion before reading the results of the sample say-on-pay vote.
examples.zh: 阅读样本「高管薪酬表决」结果前，我们先找到有关薪酬的说明。

words.enDefinition: formal agreement by shareholders under the applicable voting rules

examples.en: The fictional merger proposal required shareholder approval before the companies could proceed in the case.
examples.zh: 在案例中，这项虚构合并提案要取得「股东批准」，两家公司才能继续推进。

examples.en: Our report explained how many votes the sample needed to obtain shareholder approval.
examples.zh: 报告解释了样本中要获得「股东批准」需要多少票。

words.enDefinition: the reported outcome and counts of a vote

examples.en: The voting results showed separate totals for votes in favour of and against the proposal.
examples.zh: 「表决结果」分别列出了赞成和反对提案的票数。

examples.en: We checked the voting results against the threshold described in the sample proxy materials.
examples.zh: 我们把「表决结果」与样本股东委托投票材料所述门槛进行了核对。

words.enDefinition: the date used to determine who qualifies to vote

examples.en: The fictional company listed a voting record date several weeks before its annual meeting.
examples.zh: 虚构公司把「表决权登记日」定在年度股东大会前几周。

examples.en: Our exercise compared the voting record date with the final deadline for returning instructions.
examples.zh: 练习对比了「表决权登记日」和提交表决指示的最终期限。

collocations: eligibility on the voting record date

words.enDefinition: the shareholder whose name appears in the issuer's records

examples.en: The sample showed the nominee as the shareholder of record for the shares it held.
examples.zh: 样本显示，代名人是其代持股份对应的「登记在册的股东」。

examples.en: A shareholder of record received the proxy card directly from the company in our example.
examples.zh: 在我们的示例中，「登记在册的股东」直接收到公司寄来的投票委托卡。

collocations: a shareholder of record on that date

words.enDefinition: a person who enjoys ownership benefits despite another name appearing on the register

examples.en: The sample listed a nominee in the register while the customer remained the beneficial owner.
examples.zh: 样本在名册中登记了代名人，而客户仍是「受益所有人」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which voting document the beneficial owner received from the broker in the case.
examples.zh: 导师问，案例中「受益所有人」从券商收到的是哪种表决文件。

words.enDefinition: to own shares registered through a broker or nominee

examples.en: The tutor explained what it means to hold in street name through a brokerage account.
examples.zh: 导师解释了通过券商账户「以券商代名方式持股」是什么意思。

examples.en: Our case contrasted shares investors hold in street name with shares registered in their own names.
examples.zh: 案例比较了投资者「以券商代名方式持股」和直接以自己名义登记股份这两种情形。

collocations: choose to hold in street name
hold in street name through a broker
securities investors hold in street name

words.zhGloss: 美国证券直接登记系统
words.enDefinition: a US system for recording eligible securities directly in an investor's name electronically
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国证券直接登记系统

examples.en: The class compared the Direct Registration System with holding securities through a broker in the sample notes.
examples.zh: 同学们比较了样本说明里的「美国证券直接登记系统」和通过券商持有证券的方式。

examples.en: The exercise showed how ownership appeared in records when shares used the Direct Registration System.
examples.zh: 练习展示了股份使用「美国证券直接登记系统」时所有权在记录里怎样显示。

collocations: record shares through the Direct Registration System
eligible for the Direct Registration System

words.zhGloss: 以簿记形式持有的股份
words.enDefinition: shares recorded electronically on an issuer's or intermediary's books instead of being represented by paper certificates
acceptedZhAnswers: 以簿记形式持有的股份

examples.en: The sample account listed book-entry shares as electronic entries on the company's ownership records.
examples.zh: 样本账户将「以簿记形式持有的股份」列为公司持股记录上的电子条目。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the record of book-entry shares with a sample paper share certificate.
examples.zh: 导师把「以簿记形式持有的股份」的记录与一张纸质股票样本作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a person designated to verify and count votes at an election

examples.en: The inspector of election checked the tabulation before the meeting chair announced the final result.
examples.zh: 会议主席宣布最终结果前，「股东选举验票人」核对了票数统计。

examples.en: We found the role of the inspector of election described in the mock meeting instructions.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟会议说明里找到了「股东选举验票人」的职责。

words.enDefinition: to cancel the authority previously granted to a voting representative

examples.en: The fictional proxy instructions explained when a registered holder could revoke a proxy before the meeting.
examples.zh: 虚构的委托投票说明解释了登记股东在会议前何时可以「撤销表决委托」。

examples.en: We identified the example email that asked the company to revoke a proxy already submitted.
examples.zh: 我们找到了那封要求公司「撤销先前提交的表决委托」的示例邮件。

collocations: revoke a proxy before the meeting
a right to revoke a proxy

words.enDefinition: to count and organise votes to determine the result

examples.en: The sample meeting procedure assigned an independent inspector to tabulate the votes for each proposal.
examples.zh: 样本会议程序指定一名独立验票人「统计各项票数」。

examples.en: Our class used a simple table to tabulate the votes before comparing the two totals.
examples.zh: 我们班用一张简单表格「统计各项票数」，然后比较两个总数。

collocations: appoint someone to tabulate the votes

words.enDefinition: an arrangement allowing eligible shareholders to include nominees in company proxy materials

examples.en: The proxy access provision in our case described when shareholder nominees could appear in company materials.
examples.zh: 案例中的「股东将提名人选列入公司委托投票材料的权利」条款说明，股东提名人选何时可以出现在公司材料中。

examples.en: The class compared proxy access with a separate way of proposing candidates at the meeting.
examples.zh: 我们班把「股东将提名人选列入公司委托投票材料的权利」与会议上提出候选人的另一种方式作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a US filing informing shareholders about an action when proxies are not solicited

examples.en: The sample information statement described the action even though the company was not requesting proxies.
examples.zh: 样本「股东信息说明书」介绍了该事项，尽管公司并未征集投票委托。

examples.en: Our tutor compared an information statement for a written consent with a meeting proxy statement.
examples.zh: 导师比较了与书面同意有关的「股东信息说明书」以及会议用的股东委托投票说明书。

collocations: actions covered by an information statement

words.enDefinition: a distribution paid to shareholders in cash

examples.en: The fictional company declared a cash dividend for the shareholders entitled to the upcoming payment.
examples.zh: 虚构公司宣布将向有权领取本次派息的股东支付「现金股息」。

examples.en: We found the cash dividend in the sample brokerage statement's income section for the quarter.
examples.zh: 我们在样本券商对账单的季度收入部分找到了「现金股息」。

words.enDefinition: a dividend paid outside a company's regular dividend schedule

examples.en: In the case, the company announced a special dividend after selling one of its businesses.
examples.zh: 在案例中，公司出售一项业务后宣布派发「特别股息」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to distinguish the special dividend from the company's usual quarterly payments.
examples.zh: 导师让我们区分「特别股息」和公司的常规季度派息。

words.enDefinition: the date on which a company formally declares a dividend

examples.en: Our sample timeline recorded the dividend declaration date before the dates for eligibility and payment.
examples.zh: 我们的样本时间线在领取资格日和付款日之前记录了「股息宣告日」。

examples.en: The tutor asked which board announcement established the dividend declaration date in the fictional case.
examples.zh: 导师问，虚构案例中哪一份董事会公告确定了「股息宣告日」。

words.enDefinition: the date used to determine who is entitled to a dividend

examples.en: The sample notice gave a dividend record date and a later date for the payment.
examples.zh: 样本通知列出了「股息权益登记日」以及之后的支付日期。

examples.en: We circled the dividend record date before interpreting the eligibility column in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 在理解课堂练习的资格栏之前，我们先圈出了「股息权益登记日」。

collocations: eligibility on the dividend record date

words.enDefinition: the first trading date on which buyers do not receive the announced dividend

examples.en: The sample exchange notice placed the ex-dividend date beside the related entry for the payment.
examples.zh: 样本交易所公告把「除息日」列在对应派息记录旁。

examples.en: Our classroom calendar distinguished the ex-dividend date from the date when the dividend would be paid.
examples.zh: 课堂日历将「除息日」与实际支付股息的日期区分开来。

collocations: the date after an ex-dividend date

words.enDefinition: the date on which an announced dividend is scheduled to be paid

examples.en: The company's sample notice stated the dividend payment date beside the amount per share.
examples.zh: 公司样本通知在每股金额旁注明了「股息支付日」。

examples.en: We matched the dividend payment date to the corresponding entry in the mock brokerage statement.
examples.zh: 我们把「股息支付日」与模拟券商对账单中的相应记录进行了核对。

collocations: cash posted on the dividend payment date

words.enDefinition: a programme using dividends to buy additional shares

examples.en: The sample dividend reinvestment plan used cash dividends to acquire additional shares for registered participants.
examples.zh: 样本「股息再投资计划」用现金股息为参加计划的人再买入股份。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the dividend reinvestment plan amount appeared separately from the dividend in the statement.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么对账单把「股息再投资计划」的金额和股息分开列出。

collocations: enrol in a dividend reinvestment plan
terms of a dividend reinvestment plan

words.enDefinition: a split increasing the share count by dividing each existing share

examples.en: The fictional company completed a forward stock split that doubled the number of outstanding shares.
examples.zh: 虚构公司完成了「股票拆细」，使发行在外股份数量翻倍。

examples.en: The case showed how a forward stock split changed the number of shares in each account.
examples.zh: 案例说明「股票拆细」如何改变各个账户中的股份数量。

collocations: shares after a forward stock split

words.enDefinition: the stated relationship between old and new share counts in a split

examples.en: The split ratio in the sample replaced each old share with three new shares.
examples.zh: 样本中的「股票拆分比例」是每一股旧股拆为三股新股。

examples.en: We used the split ratio to explain the change in the mock account's share count.
examples.zh: 我们用「股票拆分比例」解释模拟账户的持股数量变化。

collocations: calculate shares using the split ratio

words.enDefinition: a historical price restated to account for a stock split

examples.en: The class used the split-adjusted price to compare the stock's quotes before and after the split.
examples.zh: 同学们用「拆分调整后的股价」比较股票拆分前后的报价。

examples.en: Our tutor checked whether the split-adjusted price appeared in the same column as the original quote.
examples.zh: 导师核对「拆分调整后的股价」是否和原报价列在同一栏。

words.expression: cash in lieu of fractional shares
words.lemma: cash in lieu of fractional shares
words.zhGloss: 代替不足一股权益的现金
words.enDefinition: cash paid instead of delivering any fractional shares
acceptedZhAnswers: 代替不足一股权益的现金
acceptedEnVariants: cash in lieu of fractional shares

examples.en: The sample consolidation notice showed cash in lieu of fractional shares beside the new share count.
examples.zh: 样本合股通知在新持股数量旁列出了「代替不足一股权益的现金」。

examples.en: We found cash in lieu of fractional shares as a separate line on the account statement.
examples.zh: 我们在账户对账单的单独一行找到了「代替不足一股权益的现金」。

collocations: pay cash in lieu of fractional shares
receive cash in lieu of fractional shares
a payment of cash in lieu of fractional shares

words.enDefinition: a communication describing a change affecting a security or its holders

examples.en: The corporate action notice explained how the fictional stock split would affect positions in brokerage accounts.
examples.zh: 「公司行动通知」解释了虚构的股票拆分会怎样影响券商账户中的持仓。

examples.en: Our tutor asked where the corporate action notice listed the dates for the proposed merger.
examples.zh: 导师问，「公司行动通知」在哪儿列出了拟议合并相关日期。

collocations: dates in a corporate action notice

words.enDefinition: an instruction selecting among options in a corporate action

examples.en: The statement recorded a corporate action election choosing cash instead of shares in the sample merger.
examples.zh: 对账单记录了持有人在样本合并中作出领取现金的「公司行动选择指示」。

examples.en: We checked whether the holder's corporate action election was recorded correctly in the example.
examples.zh: 我们核对了示例中持有人的「公司行动选择指示」是否记载正确。

collocations: record a holder's corporate action election

words.enDefinition: formal permission for a company to buy back its own shares

examples.en: The board's buyback authorization in the example set a maximum amount for purchases of shares.
examples.zh: 示例中董事会的「股份回购授权」为买入股份规定了最高金额。

examples.en: Our group discussed why a buyback authorization did not itself show that shares had been bought.
examples.zh: 我们小组讨论了为什么「股份回购授权」本身并不说明公司已经购回股份。

collocations: the limits of a buyback authorization

words.enDefinition: an invitation to holders to sell securities on stated terms

examples.en: The fictional company announced a tender offer with a stated price and a limited acceptance period.
examples.zh: 虚构公司宣布了一项规定价格和有限接受期的「证券收购要约」。

examples.en: Our exercise compared who made the tender offer with who owned the shares at the time.
examples.zh: 练习对比了提出「证券收购要约」的一方和当时持有股份的一方。

collocations: the closing date of a tender offer

words.enDefinition: cash, shares, or other value received by holders in a merger

examples.en: The sample's merger consideration consisted of cash plus shares in the company acquiring the business.
examples.zh: 样本中的「合并对价」由现金和实施收购的企业的股份组成。

examples.en: We read where the merger consideration appeared in the notice sent to shareholders about the deal.
examples.zh: 我们阅读了交易通知，查看发给股东的文件在哪儿说明「合并对价」。

words.enDefinition: the number of new shares received for each original share

examples.en: The share exchange ratio in the case gave one new share for every four held.
examples.zh: 案例中的「换股比例」是每持有四股旧股换一股新股。

examples.en: We checked the share exchange ratio before filling in the new holding on the sample statement.
examples.zh: 我们先核对了「换股比例」，再填写样本对账单中的新持仓。

collocations: agree on a share exchange ratio
shares due under the share exchange ratio

words.enDefinition: a distribution of shares in a separated business to existing holders

examples.en: The case's spin-off distribution gave the parent company's shareholders shares in the newly separate company.
examples.zh: 案例中的「分拆公司股份分配」使母公司股东取得新独立公司的股份。

examples.en: The statement showed the spin-off distribution as a new holding rather than as a cash payment.
examples.zh: 对账单将「分拆公司股份分配」列为新持仓，没有列成现金支付。

collocations: receive shares in a spin-off distribution
the ratio for a spin-off distribution

words.enDefinition: a temporary pause in trading a security

examples.en: The example exchange bulletin announced a trading halt pending an announcement from the fictional company.
examples.zh: 示例交易所公告宣布「临时停牌」，等待虚构公司发布消息。

examples.en: Our tutor differentiated a trading halt from the company's permanent removal from the sample exchange.
examples.zh: 导师区分了「临时停牌」和公司从样本交易所永久退市。

collocations: resume trading after a trading halt

words.enDefinition: a notice about removal of a security from an exchange's list

examples.en: The sample delisting notice gave the date the shares would stop trading on that exchange.
examples.zh: 样本「退市通知」列出了股份停止在该交易所交易的日期。

examples.en: We checked which share class the delisting notice referred to in the mock announcement.
examples.zh: 我们核实了模拟公告中的「退市通知」指哪个股份类别。

collocations: the date in the delisting notice

words.enDefinition: the short code used to identify a security in market quotes

examples.en: The sample exchange notice displayed the ticker symbol beside the fictional company's name and listing date.
examples.zh: 样本交易所通知在虚构公司的名称和上市日期旁显示「股票交易代码」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why a ticker symbol might have a suffix indicating a different share class.
examples.zh: 导师解释，为什么「股票交易代码」可能带有表示不同股份类别的后缀。

words.enDefinition: a nine-character identifier used for securities in the US and Canada

examples.en: The sample statement gave a CUSIP beside the company's name and the quantity of shares.
examples.zh: 样本对账单在公司名称和持股数量旁列出了「北美证券识别码」。

examples.en: We compared the CUSIP entries for two share classes issued by the same fictional company.
examples.zh: 我们比较了同一家虚构公司发行的两个股份类别的「北美证券识别码」。

words.enDefinition: a twelve-character international identifier for a financial instrument

examples.en: The exercise gave an ISIN so we could match the same security across both documents.
examples.zh: 练习给出了一个「国际证券识别码」，以便我们在两份文件中匹配同一证券。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed out that the ISIN identified the security rather than its trading venue.
examples.zh: 导师指出，「国际证券识别码」标识的是证券本身，而非其交易场所。

collocations: identify a security by its ISIN

words.enDefinition: a broker's record confirming the details of an executed trade

examples.en: The sample trade confirmation showed the price, date, and quantity for a single stock trade.
examples.zh: 样本「证券成交确认单」列出一笔股票交易的价格、日期和数量。

examples.en: We checked the trade confirmation against the entry shown in the monthly brokerage statement.
examples.zh: 我们把「证券成交确认单」与月度券商对账单上的记录作了核对。

words.enDefinition: a periodic record of a brokerage account's holdings and activity

examples.en: The sample brokerage statement listed three share holdings and two transactions during the month.
examples.zh: 样本「券商账户对账单」列出了三项股份持仓和当月的两笔交易。

examples.en: Our tutor used the brokerage statement to explain how the account's closing balance was reported.
examples.zh: 导师用「券商账户对账单」解释了账户如何列报期末余额。

words.enDefinition: the date on which a securities trade is executed

examples.en: The trade date on the sample confirmation differed from the date the shares were delivered.
examples.zh: 样本确认单上的「成交日」与股份实际交付的日期不同。

examples.en: We checked the trade date before placing the transaction in the correct row of the timeline.
examples.zh: 我们先核对了「成交日」，再把这笔交易放到时间线的正确一行。

collocations: one business day after the trade date

words.enDefinition: the interval between executing a trade and completing its settlement

examples.en: The classroom example used a settlement cycle of one business day after trade execution.
examples.zh: 课堂示例的「证券结算周期」是从成交到结算间隔一个工作日。

examples.en: Our tutor drew a timeline to show where the settlement cycle began and ended.
examples.zh: 导师画了一条时间线，说明「证券结算周期」从哪里开始到哪里结束。

words.enDefinition: settlement one business day after the trade date

examples.en: The sample US confirmation showed T+1 on a trade executed on a Monday.
examples.zh: 这笔美国样本交易于周一成交，确认单标明「次工作日结算」。

examples.en: The timeline showed T+1 on Tuesday because the trade occurred on a regular Monday.
examples.zh: 这笔交易在正常交易日周一完成，时间线上把周二标为「次工作日结算」。

words.enDefinition: the price at which a trade actually took place

examples.en: The execution price on the mock confirmation was different from the earlier quote we had recorded.
examples.zh: 模拟确认单上的「实际成交价格」与我们此前记录的报价不同。

examples.en: The worksheet multiplied the execution price by the number of shares traded before accounting for fees.
examples.zh: 练习表先将「实际成交价格」乘以成交股数，再计入费用。

collocations: the execution price for a trade

words.enDefinition: the cash payable or receivable after applicable transaction charges

examples.en: The net trade amount in the exercise reflected both the purchase cost and the stated fees.
examples.zh: 练习中的「交易净额」反映了买入成本和列出的费用。

examples.en: We reconciled the net trade amount on the confirmation with the entry in the cash ledger.
examples.zh: 我们用现金账上的记录核对确认单里的「交易净额」。

collocations: a net trade amount after charges

words.enDefinition: the amount of an order that has actually traded

examples.en: The sample's executed quantity was smaller than the number of shares originally ordered.
examples.zh: 样本中的「成交数量」少于最初下单的股数。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which line of the confirmation showed the executed quantity for the stock purchase.
examples.zh: 导师问，确认单的哪一行显示这笔股票买入的「成交数量」。

words.enDefinition: an order for which only some of the requested amount has traded

examples.en: The simulation showed a partially filled order after only six of the ten shares were bought.
examples.zh: 十股中只买入六股后，模拟系统显示为一笔「部分成交的委托单」。

examples.en: We checked whether the remaining shares on the partially filled order appeared in the second trade confirmation.
examples.zh: 我们核对了这笔「部分成交的委托单」尚未成交的股份是否出现在第二份成交确认单上。

collocations: a partially filled order for stock
remaining quantity on a partially filled order

words.enDefinition: the role in which a broker acts in a trade

examples.en: The classroom confirmation listed broker capacity separately from the price and the quantity of shares.
examples.zh: 课堂使用的确认单把「券商在交易中的身份」与股价和成交数量分开列出。

examples.en: We found the broker capacity field and checked whether the firm acted for its own account.
examples.zh: 我们找到「券商在交易中的身份」栏，核对该机构是否为自己交易。

words.enDefinition: a transaction in which the firm buys or sells for its own account

examples.en: The sample confirmation identified a principal trade because the broker sold shares from its own account.
examples.zh: 样本确认单将这笔交易标为「券商自营交易」，因为卖出的是券商自身账户中的股份。

examples.en: Our tutor explained how a principal trade would be labelled in the fictional stock transaction record.
examples.zh: 导师解释了在虚构的股票交易记录中，「券商自营交易」会怎样标注。

collocations: a broker acting in a principal trade

words.enDefinition: a transaction executed by a broker on behalf of a client

examples.en: The sample showed an agency trade for which the broker charged a stated commission.
examples.zh: 样本显示一笔「券商代理交易」，券商为此收取了列明的佣金。

examples.en: We distinguished the agency trade from another sample in which the firm used its own shares.
examples.zh: 我们把「券商代理交易」和另一份使用券商自身持股的样本区分开。

collocations: the commission on an agency trade
